About this trip

Travel is not just about seeing the world. It is about feeling it.

Eight days in the heart of East Africa, where ancient rhythms, rare wildlife, and turquoise water all meet.

Start with warm welcomes and group dinners in Arusha, then head out on a three-day safari: Tarangire's elephant herds, the Ndutu calving grounds during the Great Migration, and the crater of Ngorongoro.

You will meet Maasai warriors and Hadzabe hunter-gatherers, eat sunset meals in the bush, and browse handmade crafts in local markets.

After four days in the wild, a short flight takes you to the white sands of Zanzibar. Wander Stone Town, taste the island's spices, snorkel Mnemba's coral reef, and sail out on a sunset dhow cruise with live Swahili music.

Boutique hotels, full board, expert local guides, and all the group logistics handled for you. It suits curious travelers who want more than a holiday.
